messages.content: 你能幫我計劃我的一天嗎？我想從我在紐約的家出發，前往波士頓的一個名為「Knight Gambit」的象棋俱樂部。我想要走最快的路線。之後，我想要前往費城的另一個名為「Rook Corner」的象棋俱樂部，同樣要走最快的路線。最後，我想要回家，但這次我想要走最短的路線。你也能提供我兩個象棋俱樂部舉辦活動的詳細資訊嗎？

function.name: chess_club_details_find
function.description: Provides details about a chess club, including location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the chess club.

city.description: The city in which the chess club is located.

event.description: The event hosted by the club.

function.name: route_planner_calculate_route
function.description: Determines the best route between two points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start.description: The starting point of the journey.

method.description: The method to use when calculating the route (default is 'fastest').

message.reasoning:
The user wants help planning their day with routes and also want detailed info on events at both clubs.

We have tool `route_planner_calculate_route` to get routes. We need to call it twice:

1) From New York home to Knight Gambit in Boston - fastest route.

2) Then from Knight Gambit to Rook Corner in Philadelphia - fastest route.

3) Finally from Rook Corner back home - shortest route.

Also we need details about each club's events using `chess_club_details_find`.

So we will make calls accordingly.

But note: For first route, start: "New York Home"? They said they live in NYC; maybe just "NYC". Destination: "Boston Knight Gambit".

Second route: start: "Boston Knight Gambit"; dest: "Philadelphia Rook Corner"

Third route: start: "Philadelphia Rook Corner"; dest: "Home in NY"

For club details: Provide name and city. So for Knight Gambit: name="Knight Gambit", city="Boston". Optionally event? Not needed but can provide if known. But we don't know actual event names. Maybe return null or placeholder.

Similarly for Rook Corner: name="Rook Corner", city="Philadelphia".

We'll ask the function for details.

Thus produce three calls: one for each route, plus two for club details.

Let's do them sequentially.

First route: route_planner_calculate_route({"start":"New York","destination":"Knight Gambit","method":"fastest"}) Actually destination should include club name? Might not matter. We'll pass as "Knight Gambit, Boston".

Better: start:"New York City", destination:"Knight Gambit, Boston", method:"fastest".

Second route: start:"Knight Gambit, Boston", destination:"Rook Corner, Philadelphia", method:"fastest".

Third route: start:"Rook Corner, Philadelphia", destination:"New York City", method:"shortest".

Then club details find: {"name":"Knight Gambit","city":"Boston"} ; same for Rook Corner.

Ok let's output calls.
